title: 6.2 Sofia takes the subway
unit_outcome: Ask whether a place is near, say how people go to work and why they go somewhere, find a platform or gate, pack for a trip, find places on a street, follow and ask for directions, ask permission, buy tickets, understand delays and check in at a hotel.
goal: Say how people go to work with take and by (Sofia takes the subway to work. Diego goes to work by motorcycle.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 6.2 Ways to Travel: A1 names transport and says by bus; A1+ 6.2 says how a person gets to work. The new items are subway and motorcycle, and take + the vehicle in the he/she form (Sofia takes the subway to work.), beside A1's by (Diego goes to work by motorcycle.). 2.2's How does … go…? asks it. Each cast member has one way to work in every photo: Sofia the subway, Diego his motorcycle, Ana the bus (A1 6) and Luis his red car (A1+ 2.2).
prerequisite: A1 6.2 transport and by; A1 6.11 take; A1+ 2.2 How do/does … go…?; A1+ 3.9 work.
speaking_outcome: Stress SUB-way and MO-tor-cy-cle; say takes with a clear s. Do not require native-like speed.
